newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Santos stevedores to meet on Cosipa talks failure.
newsitem.headline: Santos stevedores to meet on Cosipa talks failure.

text.p: Stevedores at Brazil's key port of Santos will meet on July 30 to decide what action to take after steel firm Companhia Siderurgica Paulista (Cosipa) broke off talks with unions, an official said.
"So far everything is calm," said the official at the Santos Stevedores' Union.
Cosipa announced Friday it was ending talks with the stevedores and two other unions and would switch to using only private workers at the company's terminal from August 4.

Cosipa had been in talks with unions since April, when stevedores staged two strikes at Santos in protest at the steel firm's decision to use its own workers to load and unload at its private terminal.
But the union official said he did not know whether a fresh strike was in the works.
